## About
Welcome to our family business. We sell and install tires and rims, with new and used tires in all brands and sizes, plus a showroom of custom aftermarket wheels. Ask us about wheel and tire packages.
We also handle tire repairs like plugs and patches, and wheel repairs for curb scratches, paint, powder coat, dents and cracks. Pass by anytime for a wheel and brake inspection. We want to get you back on the road safe.
We're rated 4.6 from 242 Google reviews. One reviewer got a flat on the freeway and had it fixed the next day. Another stopped in with low tires and had them checked and filled with air in about a minute.

## Services
- New and used tires: New and used tires in all brands and sizes, sold and installed.
- Custom wheels and packages: Browse our showroom of custom aftermarket wheels and ask about wheel and tire packages.
- Tire repair: Plugs and patches for punctures and nails.
- Wheel repair: Fixes for curb scratches, paint, powder coat, dents and cracks.
- Wheel and brake inspection: Stop by and we'll take a look at your wheels and brakes.

## FAQ
Q: Is balancing included with new tires?
A: Yes. All new tires come with free balancing.

Q: Can you fix a tire with a nail in it?
A: Yes. We do tire repairs like plugs and patches. One reviewer had a nail in their tire and said we patched it quickly.

Q: What are your hours on Sunday?
A: On Sunday we're open from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM.
